Relates to StbM_CloneTimeBase Variation WHERE ( timeBaseType == "TBTYPE_SYNCHRONIZED" ) OR ( timeBaseType == " TBTYPE_PURELOCAL" ); cloneCfg Type StbM_CloneConfigType Direction IN Comment Refines how source Time Base is cloned to destination Variation – statusMask Type StbM_TimeBaseStatusType Direction IN Comment Status flags mask for definition of relevant status flags Variation – statusValue Type StbM_TimeBaseStatusType Direction IN Comment Status flags value define whether cloning shall take place Parameters Variation – Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK Operation GetMasterConfig Comment Indicates in postbuild use case, if the StbM is actually configured as system wide master Relates to StbM_GetMasterConfig Variation WHERE allowSystemWideMaster . isDefined (); ▽ △ masterConfig Type StbM_MasterConfigType Direction OUT Comment – Parameters Variation – Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK Operation SetBusProtocolParam Comment Operation is used to set bus specific parameters for a Time Master Relates to StbM_SetBusProtocolParam Variation LET ethDomains = ECV . subEltList ( "EthTSyn / EthTSynGlobalTimeDomain" ); refEthMasterFilter ( timeBaseRef ) = ( timeBaseRef . subElt ( "EthTSynSynchronizedTimeBaseRef" ). deref () == timeBase ); hasMasterDomain = ethDomains . filter ( refEthMasterFilter ). count () gt 0 ; WHERE (( timeBaseType == "TBTYPE_SYNCHRONIZED" ) AND hasMasterDomain ); protocolParams Type StbM_ProtocolParamType Direction IN Comment Structure with Follow_Up information TLV parameters Parameters Variation – Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK Operation SetCloningOffset Comment Sets an offset time that will be added to the synchronized time when cloning from a Source Time Base to a Destination Time Base. Relates to StbM_SetCloningOffset Variation – timeOffset Type StbM_TimeStampType Direction IN Comment Offset value for cloning Parameters Variation – Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK Operation SetGlobalTime Comment Allows the Customers to set the Global Time that will be sent to the buses and modify HW registers behind the providers, if supported. This function will be used if a Time Master is present in this ECU. Using SetGlobalTimecan lead to an immediate transmission of the Global Time. Relates to StbM_SetGlobalTime Variation – timeStamp Parameters Type StbM_TimeStampType ▽ △ Direction IN Comment – Variation – userData Type StbM_UserDataType Direction IN Comment – Variation – Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK Operation SetRateCorrection Comment Allows to set the rate of a Synchronized Time Base (being either a Pure Local Time Base or not). Relates to StbM_SetRateCorrection Variation – rateDeviation Type StbM_RateDeviationType Direction IN Comment Value of the applied rate deviation Parameters Variation – Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK Operation SetUserData Comment Allows the Customers to set the User Data that will be sent to the buses. Relates to StbM_SetUserData Variation – userData Type StbM_UserDataType Direction IN Comment New user data Parameters Variation – Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK Operation TriggerTimeTransmission Comment Allows the Customers to force the Timesync Modules to transmit the current Time Base due to an incremented timeBaseUpdateCounter Relates to StbM_TriggerTimeTransmission Variation WHERE ( timeBaseType == "TBTYPE_SYNCHRONIZED" ); Possible Errors E_OK E_NOT_OK Operation UpdateGlobalTime Comment Allows the Customers to set the Global Time that will be sent to the buses and modify HW registers behind the providers, if supported. This function will be used if a Time Master is present in this ECU.
